findings.issue: The keyed option says both models were within 15% of reference values, but the source establishes only average errors below 15% in dry stable conditions. An average does not establish that individual readings stay within that bound. Change the option to explicitly preserve average errors and dry/stable qualification.

The explanation says the volunteers-only option misidentifies survey respondents, but the script does not explicitly identify all respondents. Explain instead that volunteers-only sampling is not stated and self-selection is explicitly the largest limitation.

coverage.scope: Full AI-assisted final review of 20 items: 5 Listening, 5 Reading, 5 Writing and 5 Speaking. Entire shared script and passage read; all 40 options, zero-based keys and 10 explanations evaluated. All repeated item contexts verified byte-for-string identical to shared context. No other reviewer outputs inspected; no candidates edited.
coverage.listening: counselling overload and non-clinical purpose; 180/200=90%; no significant coursework difference; work clashes; self-selection and causality limitation; every distractor tested against full dialogue
coverage.reading: three models/reference/twelve-week design; average-versus-pointwise wording blocker; humidity bias and ModelB inference; school example patterns versus precise levels; co-location/reporting recommendation
coverage.writing: campaign complete five-source percentages across 2023/2025, adult samples and multiple-response note; field-course plans each sum100%, equal48000-dollar totals and 60 students/10 days specified; three Task2 topics allow qualified arguments; Task1 minimum150 words/20 minutes and Task2 minimum250 words/40 minutes verified.
coverage.speaking: two everyday Part1 sets; walking-route cue card has complete descriptive bullets, preparation and duration; two Part3 sets appropriately ask behaviour/evidence/funding/public-space evaluation
coverage.languageAndStage: Reviewed natural language, unsupported claims, distractor uniqueness/plausibility, stage suitability and task realism. These are staged short-form practice items, not a complete official IELTS paper or a validated band-score measure.
coverage.priorReviewExposure: No other reviewer reports inspected. Parent sent confirmation of proposed average-error blocker after this review independently identified and reported it.
